name: Checkpoints and a gentle respawn
body: The design says the game never punishes: the world changes, the player is not told off. Today falling resets to the level start and `Restart` also restores gems. Add a `checkpoint` world kind: touching one stores the respawn point, falling returns the player to the latest one with every collected gem kept.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.
